outcome: neonatal sunlight exposure practice (maternal good practice)
cohort: The study included 417 mothers selected using systematic random sampling in Jigjiga City, Ethiopia.
finding: Only 29.4% of mothers had good neonatal sunlight exposure practice, which was significantly associated with marital status, mode of delivery, maternal knowledge, and fear of sunlight exposure.
mod_finding: Mothers who delivered via caesarean section were significantly less likely to have good practices of neonatal sunlight exposure.
